# Mini Miners Pediatric Dentistry

> Board-certified pediatric dental practice in Erie, CO specializing in gentle, anxiety-free care for children from infants to teens with advanced treatments and kid-friendly amenities.

Mini Miners Pediatric Dentistry is a family-owned practice led by Dr. Alison Grover, offering comprehensive pediatric dental services including preventative care, specialized treatments for anxious children, and innovative mercury-free restorations. The practice serves Erie, Firestone, and Frederick, Colorado with a focus on making dental visits fun and comfortable through features like arcade games and movies.

## Core Pediatric Treatments

- [Dental Crowns for Kids in Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/dental-crowns-for-kids-in-erie-co): Hall Crowns and white crowns for children requiring no drilling or injections
- [White Cavity Fillings for Kids in Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/white-cavity-fillings-for-kids-in-erie-co): Mercury-free white composite fillings for children's cavities in Erie, CO
- [Sedation Dentistry Options For Kids In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/sedation-dentistry-options-for-kids-in-erie-co): Sedation options including nitrous oxide and oral conscious sedation for anxious children
- [Pediatric Dental Anxiety In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/pediatric-dental-anxiety-in-erie-co): Anxiety management strategies with sedation options for nervous children
- [Orthodontics For Kids In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/orthodontics-for-kids-in-erie-co): Phase 1 orthodontics and Invisalign for children with early intervention treatment
- [Fluoride Treatment For Kids In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/fluoride-treatment-for-kids-in-erie-co): Fluoride varnish treatment for cavity prevention and enamel strengthening
- [White Spots On Teeth Treatment For Kids In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/white-spots-on-teeth-treatment-for-kids-in-erie-co): ICON treatment for white spots and enamel lesions without drilling

## Specialized Pediatric Care

- [Pediatric Dentist For Babies In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/pediatric-dentist-for-babies-in-erie-co): Baby dental care from birth with gentle techniques and healthy habit establishment
- [Pediatric Dentist Tongue Tie In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/pediatric-dentist-tongue-tie-in-erie-co): Tongue tie (ankyloglossia) evaluation and conservative treatment for infants
- [Dental Care For Special Needs Kids In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/dental-care-for-special-needs-kids-in-erie-co): Compassionate dental care for special needs children with sedation and gentle techniques
- [Emergency Dental For Kids In Erie, CO](https://www.miniminerspediatricdentistry.com/emergency-dental-for-kids-in-erie-co): Emergency dental care for toothaches, broken teeth, and dental trauma
